dct_description_sm: We are referring here to the main social districts in Longueuil. The concept of sociological district does not refer to a formal administrative division. It illustrates the Longueuil territories (neighborhood) identified and recognized by local actors on the basis of history, belonging and socio-community organization and the challenges involved.**This third party metadata element was translated using an automated translation tool (Amazon Translate).**
